events.verdict: Kornet (SAS) jumps alongside Brown's (BOS) path to the basket when marginal contact occurs with Brown's arm after his release.
Garza (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Fox (SAS) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the drive.
Brown (BOS) has control of the ball when he makes contact with the baseline.
Garza (BOS) establishes himself in Champagnie's (SAS) path prior to the contact.
Queta (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Wembanyama (SAS) prior to incidental contact occurring.
Fox (SAS) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Brown (BOS) during the drive prior to incidental contact occurring.
White (BOS) brushes Champagnie's (SAS) arm as he makes contact with the ball during his contest of Champagnie's layup attempt.
Kornet (SAS) initiates contact with White's (BOS) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Scheierman (BOS) legally contests Wembanyama's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Queta (BOS) establishes himself in Johnson's (SAS) path prior to the contact.
Kornet (SAS) directly contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Brown's (BOS) hand after the release.
Champagnie (SAS) cleanly blocks White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
White (BOS) commits a take foul on Kornet (SAS).
